search_text: published ZDI-24-115 ZDI-CAN-22297 Centreon updateContactServiceCommands SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-02-09 CVE-2024-23117 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-23117 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Centreon'] ['Centreon'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Centreon. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the updateContactServiceCommands function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Fixed in Centreon-web versions 22.10.15, 23.04.10 and 23.10.1 https://github.com/centreon/centreon/pull/2464 ['2023-11-28 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2024-02-09 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2024-07-01 - Advisory Updated'] 129cf345fa3dcf0fd346682161ba9a4f https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-24-115/
title: Centreon updateContactServiceCommands SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Centreon. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the updateContactServiceCommands function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
